stayType: Clifftop hotel with suites and residences
accommodation: Hotel rooms and junior suites, three feature suites (Secret Suite, Signal House, The Penthouse), and residences sleeping four to six across two or three bedrooms
suitableFor: Couples, families, groups, dog owners (selected units)
dogs: Pet-friendly in Coastal Cottages, selected suites and rooms with gardens; allowed in Gara Kitchen and Residents Lounge but not the restaurant; fee charged
confirmedFeatures: Indoor pool, outdoor pool (summer), Wild Rock Spa with sauna and jacuzzi, restaurant, bar and lounge, cinema room
overview: Gara Rock is a clifftop hotel at East Portlemouth, across the estuary from Salcombe, offering rooms, suites and multi-bedroom residences. It has indoor and outdoor pools, a spa and a restaurant, with coast path walks to East Portlemouth and a seasonal passenger ferry to Salcombe.
surfTripFit: It is on the south side of the Salcombe estuary rather than at Bantham, so surfing means a drive round via Kingsbridge. Better suited to a resort-style break than a dedicated surf trip.
gaps: Parking, Wi-Fi and beach access not stated; room count not stated; located at East Portlemouth, not Bantham/Challaborough as in batch.
